ng-add.description: Adds @mk-kit/ui to an application: wires the theme stylesheet into angular.json and optionally scaffolds a provideMkI18n override block.

migrate-primeng.description: Migrates a PrimeNG app to @mk-kit/ui: rewrites imports, class names and 1:1 selectors, annotates what needs a manual touch, cleans angular.json / package.json and writes a report.
